column3: Hello, April.
What do you need, Diana?
How can I help, Diana?
What can I get you to drink, ma'am?
Nothing for me, thank you, just passing through!
Brian, isn't it?
What's it to you, Outsider?
Outsider?
Did you gain entry to our sanctum honourably, with the five-fingered handshake of formality?
I think I was unconscious when the doctor dragged me in here.
Well, that makes you an outsider!
Hello, Brian
Yes, Outsider?
Jared, is it?
Brother Jared, Custodian of the Silken Palms.
I'm entitled to a little respect around here, thank you very much.
You got any chips to cash in, ma'am?
Oh, no, thank you. I don't have any chips.
Not the gambling type, aye? I get it!
Excuse me.
My mistake!
Greetings!
AAAAAAAAAAAAUUGGHH!
Fiammetta, what have you done!
*gurgle*
C-Crawling, scratching, n-n-nibbling!
It c-came right for me!
I can't stand their b-beady little eyes!
Don't let it n-near me!
Those t-teeth!
Ahh! I c-can't get it out of my mind!
T-Their worm-like tail. It was h-horrible!
You're the detective that's been hired to case the joint, right?
Listen, I wanted to offer you my services. Just let me know if you're interested, okay?
Ready to tell me what do you need that forgery for?
Well look who's back, ready to hear about that favour?
So, how is that favour progressing?
I'm glad we could assist each other today.
Hey, beautiful! I haven't seen you around here before.
Ohh... I've been keeping to myself, that's all!
Say, you look like a well-read broad. If you're into poetry, maybe we could g-
Pfft! I'll still be here when you change your mind, lady!
Is this what you were looking for?
Ha-ha, that's it! I can't believe you actually pulled it off!
I'm not gonna lie, I underestimated you. A deal is a deal, so... take this!
Hm, what do we have here?
We're waiting to be seated, because someone forgot to make a dinner reservation.
I thought you were going to do it.
What scent are you wearing? It smells so familiar!
That would be telling, darling.
Where did you get that coat? You remind me of...
It was a gift!
Ah, our latest recruit. Putting yourself to good use?
I heard the detective on the Unterwald case disappeared, vanished into thin air!
Perhaps it's a cunning ploy of some sort, to lure out the killer?
Well, maybe the killer already got to him.
What if he was the killer all along, and he's just covering his tracks!
Now that'd be a twist! But I believe it's been done before.
Herman Merman! It is truly an honour.
Doctor Hirsch, at your service! I'm Lady Unterwald's personal physician.
Y-You know who I am?
Of course! I could hardly believe THE Herman Merman was bleeding on ME!
Herman Merman!
It was an honour to watch a master at work, I knew you'd locate that idol!
I've read all the stories of your cases, you know!
Yes, Herman?
We heard some crashing and bashing, is everything okay?
Do I need to perform a physical examina-
No, that won't be necessary, I assure you everything is fine!
Doctor Hirsch?
Yes, ma'am?
It's me, Herman. I'm in disguise!
Good heavens! Where did you go? Are you close to finding the killer?
I'll explain later, just pretend you didn't see me.
I saw nothing, Herman. I just hope you know what you're doing.
Don't tell anyone you saw me!
Oh là là! You are truly a work of art, Mademoiselle.
You simply must allow me to paint you!
Heavens, you'll make me blush!
It is decided! You shall be my next muse, just say the word.
Maybe another time.
How can I help you, monsieur?
The name's Ron, why not sit and share a drink with me?
Charmed, I'm sure, but I have pressing matters to attend to.
I hear you, ma'am. Ron will be right here if you change your mind.
They look like they're deep in conversation.
What do you think of the place? Pretty cool, huh?
The name's Gretchen. I'm in charge of all the itinerary!
Herman Merman, that's quite the costume change. Where'd you get the coat?
Wh- how did you see through my disguise so easily?
Your hand, dummy. You're still sporting that stab wound from our little knife game.
How observant... You'd make an excellent detective, you know.
Yeah, but it'd be too easy, where's the fun in that?
What are all these idols for, anyway?
Each one of these idols has a purpose, we use them to keep things orderly.
We have strict protocols, and we follow the rules here, something an outsider like you wouldn't know about, of course.
What's all this talk of a handshake?
You don't know about the handshake?
What is the point of me guarding that curtain all day, if they're going to let people in who don't even know about the handshake?
If you taught me the handshake, would I still be an outsider?
Well, the handshake gets changed every few hours. Besides, you're here now.
Are you sure you don't want to teach me the handshake?
They'll just change it in a few hours, I'd rather not waste my time.
I heard you're the Keeper Of Idols? I need a specific one.
Look, there are a lot of idols back here.
If you can narrow it down, I might be able to find what you're looking for.
Any luck finding that idol? I'm still looking for it.
Like I said, we've got a lot of idols back here.
I'm surprised you haven't sided with Mr Liu.
Really? I don't think it's all that surprising.
I don't agree with his methodology, simple as that.
Besides, he left The Order! He doesn't get to dictate the rules to us now.
Mr Liu seemed fairly upset back there.
Ah, I wouldn't read too much into it.
You're not concerned?
He's probably just gone off to sulk somewhere.
I have to go.
I'll be keeping an eye on you, Outsider.
That's all the help I need right now.
What does a Custodian of the Silken Palms do?
It's my job, nay, my sacred duty to ensure that all members' hands are thoroughly moisturised.
I wish I could unhear that information.
As you can tell, it's not a duty I take lightly. Nothing but moist palms, all round!
Please, stop saying moist.
How'd you get roped into joining this secret society?
I was in it originally to help keep the company on track, you know?
But over time, we got a bit hung up on the ‘helping hands' theme.
You're saying it all got rather heavy-handed.
Exactly! Next thing I know, we're talking secret handshakes, the best hand creams, cuticle care... the works!
I'm way too far down this rabbit hole to climb out now.
I have some questions about the hand idol.
Of course, I'll try to help as best I can.
Do you remember what the idol was made of?
Oh, you mean the Lady Unterwald idol?
Well, it was definitely silver. Or was it solid gold?
Oh dear, it's been too long, I'm afraid!
Can you recall what gesture the idol was making?
Well, it was certainly a hand gesture...
Can you recall any specifics?
Sorry, pal. If you moisturise enough hands, they all kind of blur together!
Was there a quote on the idol?
A quote? Yes, there was definitely something sentimental about it.
Sorry I couldn't be more helpful.
What's Mr Liu so impatient about?
Oh, don't mind him. He just expects everything to go his way all the time!
Jian is a man of action, but we have processes in place for a reason!
I thought Jian raised some rather urgent points.
I agree, but we can't go barrelling in there and meddling with Lady Unterwald's affairs.
It's much better to take a deliberate, more thought out approach.
It seems the voting has stalled. Any ideas?
We'll need a coherent answer out of Mr Masson in order to break the deadlock.
Perhaps you can persuade him in some way?
Talk to you later, I have to go...
Any tips on catching that mouse?
It won't be easy, attorney. That little devil has shortcuts everywhere.
We tried to plug them all up, but there's too many!
Good news, I've apprehended that mouse!
What should I do with this mouse?
Give it here, attorney.
No one lays a whisker on Fiametta without facing consequences!
Hmm I think I'll hang onto her for now.
It's your funeral, attorney.
Any chance of a tour of the kitchen?
A tour? I'm afraid a tour of the kitchen will have to wait.
The timing right now? It's not ideal.
Oh, that's okay.
Ahh, you twist my arm, attorney. Of course, I'll give you a tour!
Come closer, and I will show you the star of the show. Fiametta!
You should tell me all about Fiametta!
You really want to know?
No, I'm not sure that you can handle it.
I can handle it, give me the full spiel on Fiametta!
Okay, well, you asked for it.
Allow me to introduce you to Fiametta, referred to by her manufacturers as the Easy Chef 500. She comes forged in cast iron steel...
Fiametta has not one, but two baking ovens! A broiler drawer that's ideal for browning the tops of casseroles, caramelising your meats, or even roasting your vegetables. But that's not all!
It's not?!

We're not talking your standard dual cook-top burners, we're not even talking four. Fiametta has six cook-top burners, an upper warming compartment that keeps optimum temperatures for your soups and sauces, and if that wasn't enough, a lower storage drawer for your additional kitchenware.
Wow!
I assume you've heard about Lady Unterwald?
Ah, attorney, c'est une tragédie !
It's terrible! We even had to throw away perfectly good ingredients to fit her in the pantry.
Excuse me?
You heard me. Don't go snooping around in the freezer, or you'll give yourself a scare.
Are you saying Lady Unterwald is stored in your freezer?
Lady Unterwald needs to be on ice until the authorities can reach us.
There was no other alternative, attorney!
I don't think Lady Unterwald would have approved of your storage methods.
Would you prefer Lady Unterwald to lay where she fell, in front of her paying passengers?
When you consider the alternative, this is a more dignified resting place, no?
I suppose so.
I should get back to finding that mouse.
Good luck, attorney.
I need to go now.
Did you say you had an inspection earlier?
The health department sent a puny little drone to inspect our premises.
If there's anything I detest more than rodents, it's health inspectors.
Strutting about as if they rule the roost, they are the real pests!
You mentioned the mouse only steals valuables?
Indeed, we're down to our last cheese knife.
It's also found a way into our pantry, there must be tunnels everywhere.
Where do you think that mouse came from, anyway?
It's not uncommon for rodents to sneak aboard a departing train.
But that mouse? That little devil came from the gates of hell!
Tell me more about your rodent problem.
That creature is no ordinary rodent, it's pure evil.
It's out there... watching us, plotting its next attack.
Calm down, Remy. Our attorney is on the case!
Any advice on nabbing that mouse?
I'd try to trap it in an enclosed space.
It won't be so simple, though. That little thief is a professional.
Mind if I have a poke around your kitchen?
Poke around?
You may have free rein of the kitchen, but there is to be no poking!
Good luck, attorney. We're counting on you.
I'll leave you to it.
Merci, attorney.
What's making you so jittery?
That creature is out there... watching us, plotting its next attack.
Ugh, the mere thought of it makes my skin crawl!
I'll bet that mouse is just as scared of you, as you are of it!
Please don't say that word! You're making me itch!
Are you feeling a bit more at ease now?
Knowing that vile beast is safely contained is a big weight off my mind.
I cannot thank you enough, attorney.
Any advice for capturing that mouse?
D-don't try to touch it with your bare hands, they c-can be extremely vicious.
Beware of the bite, got it.
Ugh, you just reminded me of those horrible gnawing teeth.
I'm feeling nauseous just thinking about it!
I don't care what you do, as long as you keep it far away from me!
Tell me, what's your role in the kitchen?
As the Entremétier, it's my job to prepare the entrées.
Between you and me, I think I was only hired to help François with his palate problem.
There's a problem with the head chef's palate?
Oui, I'm afraid his taste is as dull as dishwater!
Don't speak a word of this to anyone, I'm afraid he's quite sensitive about it.
You taste all the food before it leaves the kitchen?
I'm supposed to, but how can I taste anything with that rodent running around?
I can't be expected to work under these conditions!
They've got you shucking oysters, huh?
I don't mind it!
Have you tried oysters before? They're a delicacy, no?
Turns out my stomach has a delicacy, so I think I'll give them a miss going forward.
I'd better get back to it.
Please hurry, I can't take much more of this.
I'll leave you to your work.
Merci!
There's something written on this napkin, right?
Do I really need to say it?
Yes, there's something written on that napkin.
You said Lady Unterwald's death wasn't part of the plan?
Did I say that? I must have misspoke.
What plan are you talking about?
That's classified, I'm afraid. These lips are sealed.
Classified?
Where are we supposed to be rendezvousing again?
Trust me, you have all the information you need.
Never mind, I'll be on my way.
I'll be seeing you.
What can you tell me about the Keeper of Many Idols?
Brother Brian? He has a good eye for detail.
We put him on security most nights, he seems to enjoy it.
We like to keep him busy, you see.
How'd you end up as the leader of a secret society?
Same as all the other secret societies. We took a vote!
Fire away!
Hmm, let me think.
Some sort of metal, was it? No, that's not right.
You know, the same guy who made the idol also sculpted the Unterwald busts.
You mean the statues I've seen around the train?
I wouldn't be surprised if they used the same material!
Ah, I remember it being a majestic pose.
I always thought it captured Lady Unterwald perfectly.
I don't suppose you remember the quote on the idol?
Hmm, I think it was something sappy. Was it something about family?
Very well, anything else?
Aren't you worried about Mr Liu?
He did seem pretty irate, I hope he doesn't do anything rash.
I should be leaving now.
Farewell!
You need an itinerary? What does that entail?
Oh my goodness, what doesn't it entail?

There's the two-hour all-hands meeting on the candles, somebody's got to maintain the weekly rota for the plumping up of the sofa cushions, and I didn't even mention the five-fingered handshake of formality.
We change that twice daily, you know!
So, wait a second. You just spend all your time in meetings?
You really think we should just light up a bunch of candles without having a long meeting about it beforehand?
Has everyone rolled up their sleeves? What's the consistency of the wax? Are we absolutely sure there's nothing flammable nearby?
How'd you end up in the Order of Idle Hands?
Honestly, when I got here, there was no structure at all. I mostly joined out of pity.
I've got a production background, so if there's a chart or a spreadsheet involved, sign me up!
I also double as the fire marshal, can't be too careful around all these open flames!
Indeed!
Mr Liu seems quite irate at The Order. What happened?
Oh, he's probably just stewing over the sandwiches we'd bring in for lunch.
You know, those mini sandwiches with the crusts cut off?
He couldn't stand them!
Mr Liu disagreed with you over sandwiches?
It's not like I made them personally, but you should have heard him!
“It ruins the structural integrity of the sandwich, Gretchen!”
“That's where all the flavour and texture is, Gretchen!”
It was all downhill from there, really.
I have some questions about the missing hand idol.
Hmm, the idol...
The Unterwald idol was pretty fancy, but I couldn't tell you what it was made of.
I don't remember it being an offensive gesture. Does that help?
I suppose it narrows it down.
There was! It was something involving the Unterwalds.
Why aren't you voting for direct action?
We can't go rushing around, meddling in Lady Unterwald's affairs!
There are long-established, extremely slow processes we must abide by.
Is the vote still deadlocked?
Rules are rules, we can't do anything until everyone here has cast their vote.
But we can call another vote at any time?
Of course, anyone present can request another vote.
You'll just need to ask the leader.
I should go.
I've always wanted to join a secret society!
What's it like being in The Order Of Idle Hands?
All too familiar, I'm afraid.
There's ceremonial robes and subterfuge.
But at the end of the day, I'm still serving drinks and nibbles.
Ah, but I'll bet those appetisers are from an equally secret menu?
I couldn't possibly say, sir.
Don't worry, your secret is safe with me!
Indeed. I believe the kitchen is up and running again.
Did you know the kitchen has a mouse problem?
I've heard the rumours, but no need to worry. It's poppycock!
I saw it! They tell me it's even been stealing valuables!
Forgive me if I find that hard to believe.
It's true, there's a mouse in the kitchen!
Wanna see the mouse again?
Have you seen a doctor's briefcase around here?
A briefcase? I'm afraid not.
Mr Masson may have seen it, you could try asking him.
What's the matter with Mr Masson?
The doctor suspected a highly acute case of alcohol poisoning.
What has Mr Masson been drinking?
It's a nigh lethal combination of ethanol, cocktail perfume and assorted petal leaf.
All mixed to perfection within a single, large container.
Does this drink have a name?
Rose buuuud.
Indeed. Mr Masson refers to it as the Rosebud.
MMmwwaah!
How do I get one of those Rosebuds?
Mr Masson has become quite fond of them. He may be holding the last one.
However, you could check with the barman to be sure.
Alright!
Remind me again, what's in a Rosebud?
Of course!
I'd best be going.
It's Doctor Hirsch's medical bag.
I can't believe you talked me into this, you blockhead!
I was sure it was this way!
Get out of there, both of you! It's not designed to support your weight.
Hey!
It's Gunter who can't stop snacking.
At least I know about portion control!
ENOUGH!
But mother, we found the entrance to Lady Unterwald's office!
You did?!
Were you able to hear anything?
It sounds like arguing, but it's too muffled.
Maybe you could squeeze through, Herman?
Uhh, I don't know about th-
Great idea, mummy!
Yes, yes! I know. It's all coming together. Quickly now!
I don't thi-
What's going on back there?
Are you sure there's nothing going on back there?
Nothing you need to know about.
Anyone else caught sight of that suave businessman aboard?
No, pray tell.
He goes by Jian. I heard he was a property magnate!
No, no. Apparently he's an oil man.
Well, consider my interest thoroughly piqued!
Did you see that drunkard being dragged out of the dining carriage?
I suppose some people just can't handle their liquor!
Good thing the doctor was on hand to help.
Hold on, there's a doctor aboard? Is he single?
You'd better call him over, I can feel the vapours coming on!
I wouldn't hold out hope, Evelyn. He seems quite attached to Lady Unterwald.
Follows her around all day like he's her pet, bless him.
Does anyone ever make money on those things?
Don't you go jinxing me, I was on a winning streak!
How are those slots treating you now?
Poorly.
Thanks a lot, Mister!
I wouldn't waste my coin on these games of chance.
I'm a writer, I don't have money to burn!
Lady Unterwald certainly knows how to make an impression.
Who'd risk all that?
I'm sensing you're not the gambling type!
The water is undulating quite hypnotically with the train's motion.
When life gives you lemons, there's plenty to be bitter about.
What's in these?
That's ''Express Reserve'' whiskey, would you like one?
No, thanks, I've got to stay sharp!
I don't find these napkins particularly note-worthy.
Couldn't hurt to take a napkin, I suppose.
I don't think I'll need another one.
I don't think I will.
Hmm, the signature is definitely cursive...
Aghhh!
Geez, relax! That's just Nibbles. She's my associate.
Associate? It's a dirty rat!
Nibbles is a mouse, you dummy. And even if she were a rat, she'd be very good at keeping her trap shut...
You wouldn't squeal on me, would you Nibbles?
Besides, she's got a real nose for valuables.
Just today, she sniffed out this pearl necklace from some rich dame, hah!
Oyster pearls kinda creep me out, though. Not a big fan of the ocean, personally.
Look, can you forge that signature or not?
Yeah, this should be pretty easy. Just tell me, what do you need it for?
It's the magnet I secured for Donny.
I can't imagine what he'd need it for, though.
That's for me to know, and you to not find out.
How long has this been here?
Not sure, but I know that dish didn't have mushrooms when I ate it.
Ughh.
Why the honeymoon suite, exactly?
I enjoy my privacy. Nobody's gonna risk walking in on some honeymooners.
A friend of yours?
It's for my gynaecomastia, alright?
I need the additional support, not that it's any of your business.
What's the occasion?
You need an occasion to enjoy the finer things?
Is this part of your next hustle?
You ask a lot of questions, you know that?
Are you looking to get implicated?
This must be how Donny's pet accomplice moves about the train.
It's just a pile of ball bearings.
You just wait till I magnetise them.
Hey, no touching!
Hold on, gentlemen, I think he's coming round.
Wh-what happened?
His Hand!
Poor thing!
Not to worry, though! I brought you to the experts. We managed to get you all patched up.
Here, take this hand cream. It's the good stuff. Loosens any cramps right up.
It also moisturises!
Where am I?
No need to fret, Herman. You're in safe hands here.
Although the members need their table back, there's a meeting starting soon.
Everyone, our meeting can now commence!
At last! I have much to discuss with you.
Hold on, where's the hand idol?
You know, the hand idol we use to signify that it's our turn to speak!
SILENCE!
Sorry! I'm getting ahead of myself.
Brother Jared speaks the truth. We cannot proceed without the hand idol.
It's bound to turn up somewhere, it couldn't have gone far!
I really must insist we press on. This issue with Lady Unterwald, it cannot wait!
We must be patient, Jian. The hand works in mysterious ways.
That's right.
So, you're all going to sit here and do nothing?
You know, I'm quite good at finding things. I may be able to assist?
Yes, that would be most appreciated!
Oh! We could ask the Keeper of Many Idols!
That's a grand idea!
Are you there, Keeper Of Many Idols?
KEEPER OF MANY IDOLS? Are you there?
BRIAN!
Yes?
I shall enquire with Brian, the Keeper Of Many Idols.
This is the work of that meddling murine, no question.
Non mais, et puis quoi encore !
Quoi ! What is it you want? As you can see, we're very busy here.
We're in the middle of dinner prep. What is it?
Back again? C'est une honte !
Pour qui tu te prends ! What is it you want?
Pardon?
He says you're pushing your luck! What is it you want?
It smells like onion soup.
That's a well stocked spice rack!
Well, that's a twist.
YOU!
It took me hours, but I finally clawed my way out of that case!
Mr Liu! Where have you been?
Thought you could get away with it, did you?
What the hell did I do?
Not you, idiot. This imposter is walking around in my suit!
I am?
And where is his accomplice, that bumbling detective?
I'm afraid he vanished without a trace. We'll likely never see him again!
AAAAAHHHH!
My goodness, that woman needs our assistance!
Don't worry, I've got her!
No, I've got her!
You're interfering with my heroic rescue!
*Gasp*
Now that's a twist.
Herman Merman, how kind of you to rejoin us.
Now, what are we going to do with you?
Oh, look!
Another tunnel.
I'm not sure if I'm in need of a boot polish right now.
Somebody on staff must have made a grave omission.
These shelves don't seem to be carrying any of my works.
I think it's best if I left the singing to the professionals.
Alas, if only I knew how to tickle those ivories.
This must be the entrance to the backstage area.
The door is bolted shut, I'm not getting through there.
It's the VIP guest list for the Green Room, but my name is notably absent.
Don't they know who I am?
It's the guest list for the Green Room, with one notable amendment.
Herman Merman, VIP!
Sorry, wrong room!
It's full of baggage.
It's a luggage cart for transporting various baggage.
I'm not in need of a pamphlet to dictate my travel plans.
Ah, I believe this is Lord Unterwald.
The late husband of Lady Unterwald.
It's a bust of Lady Unterwald, there's a small engraving at the base.
There's something written here, but it's too small to make out.
Our records show that you were in the luggage storage room when the murder took place?
That's right. Arthur came running in to tell me there'd been a murder.
They needed a detective, after all. I was happy to step up!
I dread to imagine what vicious creature was responsible for this.
I think lifting this would kill me.
I'm not in need of any new undergarments.
Let's hope it stays that way.
This is why I always prefer to travel light.
It looks fairly impenetrable.
How long would you say you were hiding in that wardrobe, Herman?
It's hard to say, I was busy weighing up my options, considering my next moves.
That's Herman. He sounded terrified!
Do you think he's wrapped up in Lady Unterwald's death?
I can't say for sure, but I think it's time we found out.
They can't know about Jian, Herman. Keep it together!
Think, Herman... Think!
Herman Merman, Master of Disguise!
Herman Merman, we meet at last. Welcome aboard the Reuss Express!
Please accept my apologies for the unusual manner of your arrival.
As I'm sure you can understand, a certain amount of discretion was required.
Forgive me, you must be wondering what it is you're doing here, aboard my train.
Oh ho ho ho! My goodness, no!
A world-famous detective running amok on my train? Everyone would be losing their minds before supper!
I hear you're writing your next novel? I felt you could adequately mask your activities as a working novelist.
To the average passenger, you'd simply be researching your next story.
Do you think you could do that, Herman? Keep a low profile, not cause a scene?
I could always call Dirk Chiselton. It wouldn't be as clean, but-
Lady Unterwald!
Away, back into the case with you!
Lady Unterwald, please forgive me if I am intruding.
Not at all, Mr Liu. What a pleasure it is to see you again!
Please, I must insist you call me Jian.
Here, I brought you something.
Not quite. It's a chilli plant, a particularly fiery variety.
It reminded me of you, my lady.
My goodness, Jian! You'll turn me bright red.
But I know you didn't come all this way just to flatter me.
Indeed. I was wondering if you'd given any more thought to my proposal?
If you're considering selling your legacy, I want you to know that it'll be in good hands.
Look Jian, I-
You need more time to consider, of course.
There are still a few more hours before the speech. I'll leave you to weigh your options.
You're most kind, thank you, Jian.
Alright, you can come out.
This is why you're here, Herman. I need you to keep an eye on Mr Liu for me.
At the very least, I suspect he doesn't have my full interests at heart.
There's also the question of my family, who will undoubtedly be sticking their noses into my business.
I've got them sufficiently shaking in their boots ahead of my speech, but keep an eye out for any trouble, will you?
I've secured a suite for you onboard, Room 304.
Just let me know if you find anything untoward.
Get to it then, detective.
I understand your concerns, Lady Unterwald. But I really must press you for an answer!
I refuse to be rushed into a decision, Jian.
I know this must be difficult, but the Unterwald empire would be safe in my hands.
Is that what you think?
You'd rather entrust your legacy to those incompetent nephews of yours?
Your scheming sister-in-law? You know she wants the estate for herself.
Just listen to that, your empire is crumbling around you!
You must reconsider!
You think I'd sell to some oil baron who's just looking to buy out his competition?
Over my dead body, Jian!
You think a solution is going to just drop out of the sky?
Is he dead?
He's not moving!
What's that in his hand?
I can't leave now, this is important.
''Board Reuss Express. Await further instructions from contact.''
So... this was Jian's plan all along.
